label: Bible Study
prompt: Flee also _____ lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verse: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
note: Paul to Timothy — run from what drags you down, run toward what's right.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: He raiseth up the poor out of the _____, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.
verse: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.
note: Hannah's song: God lifts the poor out of the dust and seats them among princes — a total turnaround.

label: Sunday School
prompt: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, _____ I was blind, now I see.
verse: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
note: The healed man couldn't win a theology debate, but he had one unbeatable argument: 'whereas I was blind, now I see.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the thing which I greatly _____ is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verse: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
note: Job's worst nightmare came true — and he says so honestly instead of pretending.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He that _____ his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verse: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
note: Cover-up versus confession: hide your sins and you won't prosper; confess and forsake them and you'll find mercy.
